Start with a clear brief

Most office searches go wrong before the first site visit, because the requirement was never pinned down. Before we shortlist anything, we agree on:

  • Headcount today and in two to three years, and your working pattern. A hybrid team that is in the office three days a week needs fewer seats than one that is in every day.
  • Location: where your people commute from, closeness to clients, and access to rail and metro lines.
  • All-in budget: rent plus maintenance, parking, power, fit-out and deposits, not just the quoted rent.
  • Timeline: your move-in date, working back through fit-out, approvals and notice on your current premises.
  • Special needs: a server room, high power load, 24x7 access, a ground-floor branch frontage, or a strong-room for BFSI branches.

Carpet area versus chargeable area

Commercial rents in India are usually quoted on chargeable area, sometimes called super built-up area, which includes your share of lobbies, lifts, staircases and other common areas. The space you can actually use, the carpet area, is often only around 65% to 75% of the chargeable area. Two buildings quoting the same rent per square foot can therefore cost very different amounts per usable square foot. We compare every option on cost per usable square foot and cost per seat, so you are comparing like with like.

What a proper evaluation checks

  • Building approvals: an occupancy certificate, the building's fire NOC, and confirmation that commercial use is permitted.
  • Infrastructure: sanctioned power load and backup capacity, air-conditioning type and hours, after-hours charges, lifts, washrooms and parking ratio.
  • Condition: leaks, structural issues and the state of common areas, and whether the space is offered as bare shell, warm shell or fully fitted.
  • Location: commute times for your team, public transport, food options and how safe the area is late in the evening.
  • Total cost of occupancy: rent, maintenance charges, property tax share, parking, power, fit-out cost, the cost of locking up the deposit, and stamp duty and registration.

Commercial terms worth negotiating

The rent is only one line in the agreement. The terms below often matter more over a three- to nine-year tenure:

  • Escalation: whether rent rises every year or in a larger step every three years, and by how much.
  • Lock-in period: how long neither side can exit, and what happens if you need to leave early.
  • Security deposit: how many months' rent, and when and how it is refunded.
  • Rent-free fit-out period: time to complete your interiors before rent starts.
  • Landlord works: what the landlord will complete before handover, such as air-conditioning, flooring or washrooms.
  • Exit and reinstatement: what condition you must return the space in, and who pays for that.
  • Renewal: your right to renew, and how the rent will be set at renewal.

In Maharashtra, leave-and-licence and lease agreements must be stamped and registered, so stamp duty and registration charges belong in your move-in budget. We coordinate the legal review with your lawyer before anything is signed.

Bare shell, warm shell or managed office?

A bare shell gives you the most control and usually the lowest rent, but you pay for and manage the whole fit-out. A warm shell comes with some services, such as air-conditioning, ceilings or washrooms, already in place. A managed or fully fitted office costs more per seat but needs no capital outlay and can be ready in weeks. For small teams or short horizons, a managed office is often the better deal. We include all three in the comparison when they fit your brief.

FAQs

Business Space Sourcing: common questions

How far ahead should we start looking for an office?

For a bare-shell office that needs a full fit-out, start four to six months before your move date. Finding and negotiating the space takes several weeks, and the fit-out and approvals take longer. For a managed office, a few weeks can be enough.

Why compare offices on carpet area?

Because rents are quoted on chargeable area, which includes common areas. The usable share varies from building to building, so the cheapest rent per square foot is not always the cheapest office.

Can you also handle the fit-out after we sign?

Yes. Our interior setup team can take over from the signed agreement through to handover, so one partner manages the move from start to finish.

Do you work outside Pune and Mumbai?

Yes. We work with businesses across India. Tell us the city and locality in your enquiry.
